summary: Completed comprehensive testing of F6 (Category Management) and F9 (Order Creation with Product Picker) features. All backend APIs working correctly (9/9 tests passed). Frontend UI integration verified for all critical user stories including multi-product orders, stock validation, product picker with blocked items, category filters, and data health warnings.

Backend API: Catalog search has all required fields (catalog_item_id, sku, name, available, sellable, block_reason, etc.)
Backend API: Blocked items have correct reasons (CLN-0001-HTM-L: 'Stok jual habis', LEGACY-NOLINK-001: 'Belum tertaut')
Backend API: Search & filter work correctly (q=hoodie, only_sellable=true)
Backend API: Create order with single product (2 pcs reserved)
Backend API: Create order with 2 products - K-8b multi-line reservation (5 pcs total, linked_line_count=2)
Backend API: Reject order with unknown SKU (400 error)
Backend API: Reject order with insufficient stock (409 error)

USER STORY 2: Stock validation - qty=999 shows warning 'Melebihi stok jual: tersedia X pcs', Save button DISABLED

USER STORY 4: Blocked items visible with reasons (3 items with block_reason displayed)

USER STORY 5: Search 'zzzz' shows empty state 'Tidak ada produk katalog yang cocok'

USER STORY 9: Live stock display with on-hand/reserve breakdown visible for all items

Regression: Catalog module loads correctly, stats dashboard shows 11 total items, 9 available, 0 low stock, 2 out of stock
